data.name: Rayyan
data.gender_notes: Rayyan is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Watered; lush; (also) a gate of paradise
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ر-و-ي (r-w-y), 'to be watered, refreshed'. Rayyān means 'watered, lush'. Its root is ر-و-ي (r-w-y). In tradition, al-Rayyān is a gate of paradise for those who fast. Rayyan is a Arabic name meaning “Watered; lush; (also) a gate of paradise”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rayyan total 30, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.
